note: Growth and keep for the creatures the family holds (roadmap item 56, first part). Years are the world clock's (pass_time). A creature is an egg (egg-layers only), then young, adult, elder, and dies of old age; how long each lasts is set by its size class. Keeping costs gold each year, paid from the heir's gold; unpaid years sink its mood, and at no mood an egg spoils and a creature wanders off. No dice are drawn: the length of an elder's life varies with a value taken from the dynasty seed and the creature's id.

text.spoils: The egg {name} has gone cold and spoiled.
text.leaves: Neglected, {name} the {species} wanders off and does not come back.
text.keep: Keep: {gold} gold a year, paid by the heir as the years pass.
